Glossary of photography terms

Short definitions of terms you will meet in our lessons.

A B D
Aperture
The opening in a lens that lets light reach the sensor. A wider aperture lets in more light.
Bokeh
The soft, blurred look of out-of-focus areas in a photo.
Depth of field

The range of distance that appears sharp in an image.

See also: aperture.

ISO
A setting that controls how sensitive the sensor is to light.
